scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw per-point data is infeasible because the public output contract provides only summary slopes/R², not individual (δ,a_X) points; we compare reported ξ and formation parameters to paper gold with tolerances and enforce diagnostics-vs-results consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold interaction energies for CeH2+δ (Lundin data) from Table 1 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: Hydrogen interstitial interaction energies in cerium dihydride
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the paper's Table 1
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported experimental values for the same system and conditions the agent must reproduce.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold interaction energies for ThC1-δ (analysed as CTh1+δ) from Table 2 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2: Carbon vacancy interaction energies in thorium monocarbide
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the paper's Table 2
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported experimental values for the same system.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold vacancy-pair formation enthalpy and entropy for YH2-δ from the paper text
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'values of -2.35 kcal/mole and -1.37 cal/deg mole were calculated for the enthalpy and entropy of vacancy pair formation'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's central derived parameters for YH2-δ.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected predominant defect types for the three systems
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper conclusions: hydrogen vacancies for YH2-δ, hydrogen interstitials for CeH2+δ, carbon vacancies for ThC1-δ
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's defect identification statements
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's main qualitative results.

outputs.description: Diagnostic data for each defect model at each temperature for YH2, CeH2, and ThC. The verifier recomputes linear regressions from the provided (x_i,y_i) pairs and checks slope consistency.
Final extracted interaction energies, defect types, and for YH2 the formation enthalpy and entropy. The verifier compares these reported values to a hidden paper-based gold within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All temperatures for YH2 and CeH2 are in °C; for ThC they are in K. The formation enthalpy is in kcal/mol, the entropy in cal/(deg·mol).
